hero.title: Stay, dine and celebrate in the heart of Monaragala
hero.body: Clean, comfortable rooms, a wedding hall with an in-house kitchen, and Elo's House restaurant — all a short walk from the Monaragala clock tower.

offers.title: Dining at Elo's House
offers.body: Rice & curry, kottu, fried rice and more — dine in, takeaway or delivery.
